name: fix83_hut_floor

notes: G3_Architecture_Fishinghouse_01 at (840.02, 21.49, -198.84), Cell_20_16; its chest G3_Object_Interact_Animated_Chest_02 at (844.45, 21.49, -196.73), beds at (842.34, -195.94) and (844.79, -198.48). Needs the cell colliders rebuilt (G3CollisionBuilder.RebuildCells) after the fix-83 water rule; before, the hut had no collider at all (heroy ~19.5 on the terrain).
